title: The video skill, in one minute

scenes.text: Every frame of this video was made in code, by Claude.
It starts from a brief in numbers, not adjectives. Premium becomes a spring that barely bounces.
One skill makes app walkthroughs, diagrams that explain an idea, 3D objects, and loops that land on the beat.
Change the style pack, and the same story is printed, pixelated, or cut from paper.
It writes the script, records the voice, and times every move to the words.
Then it reviews its own frames, like an animator. Contact sheets. Onion skins. Speed graphs. And a test for every number in the brief.
It's free and open source. Install it with one line, and make your own.
